questions.question: The Dense predictions match after transposing weights. What has been established?
options: The tested inference mapping matches for these inputs.
Optimizer and random state are now equivalent.
Any runtime can execute the model.
questions.explanation: The comparison establishes bounded numerical equivalence. Training state, other operators, shapes and target runtime support each need their own evidence.
optionFeedback: The comparison establishes bounded numerical equivalence. Training state, other operators, shapes and target runtime support each need their own evidence.
Inference-weight parity does not map optimizer history or random state. Training continuation requires a larger conversion contract.
A tested Dense mapping cannot establish compatibility with every runtime, operator or architecture. Expand cases before expanding the claim.
